evidence.text: Look for. The exact mechanics of a Grand Slam Offer that shifts purchases from price-driven to value-driven. The Value Equation formula: (Dream Outcome x Perceived Likelihood of Achievement) / (Time Delay x Effort & Sacrifice). The "Trim & Stack" method for bundling: listing problems, turning them into solutions, finding delivery vehicles, and explicitly trimming high-cost/low-value items. Specific guarantee structures (e.g., Unconditional, Service Guarantee, Anti-Guarantee) and the margin math justifying them (e.g., closing 130% more people with a 10% refund rate still yields a 23% net increase in sales). The 4 methods of urgency: Cohort-Based, Rolling Seasonal, Pricing/Bonus-Based, and Exploding Opportunity. The 3 methods of scarcity: Limited Supply of Seats/Slots, Limited Supply of Bonuses, and "Never available again". The M-A-G-I-C naming formula: Magnet (Reason Why), Avatar, Goal, Interval, Container.
